A line passes through the points (0, 0) and (10, 320) in the xy−plane. Which equation represents this line?
questions.explanation: The line passes through the origin with slope 320/10 = 32, so y = 32x.

questions.question:
The graph of y = f(x) is shown.
What is the y-intercept of the graph of y = f(x) + 13?
questions.explanation: The graph of f crosses the y-axis at (0, 1); adding 13 moves it to (0, 14).

questions.question: What is an equation of the graph shown?
questions.explanation: The line crosses the x-axis at (3, 0) and the y-axis at (0, −5), so its equation is 5x − 3y = 15.

questions.question: Line s is defined by x − 4y = 24. Line t is perpendicular to line s in the xy−plane and passes through the points (k, 0) and (60, −k). What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Line s has slope 1/4, so line t has slope −4. Then −k/(60 − k) = −4, so k = 240 − 4k and k = 48.

questions.question: A book-of-the-month club charges $13 for the first book purchased during the month and an additional $11 for each book after the first. Which equation describes this situation, where y is the total cost, in dollars, for books purchased during a month, x is the number of books purchased during the month, and x > 0?

The function f(x) = 19(x − 6)2 + 3 gives a toy car’s height above the ground f(x), in inches, x seconds after it started moving on an elevated track, where 0 ≤ x ≤ 10. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?
options: The toy car’s minimum height was 3 inches above the ground.
The toy car’s minimum height was 6 inches above the ground.
The toy car’s height was 3 inches above the ground when it started moving.
The toy car’s height was 6 inches above the ground when it started moving.
questions.explanation: The vertex is (6, 3) and the parabola opens upward, so the minimum height is 3 inches.

questions.question: For the polynomial function f, the graph of y = f(x) in the xy−plane passes through the points (−4, 0), (1, 0), and (9, 0). Which of the following must be a factor of f(x)?
questions.explanation: The graph crosses the x-axis at x = 1, so f(1) = 0 and (x − 1) is a factor.

questions.question:
x2 + y2 = 3,185
y − 8x = 0
A solution to the given system of equations is (x, y), where x < 0. What is the value of y?
questions.explanation: Substituting y = 8x gives 65x^2 = 3,185, so x^2 = 49 and x = −7. Then y = 8(−7) = −56.

questions.question: For the exponential function f, the value of f(1) is k, where k is a constant. Which of the following equivalent forms of the function f shows the value of k as the coefficient or the base?
questions.explanation: In choice C, f(1) = 144.5(1.7)^0 = 144.5, and 144.5 appears as the coefficient.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = |x|a − 14, where a < 0. What is the product of f(15a) and f(8a)?
The result of increasing the quantity x by 600% is 126. What is the value of x?
What is the approximate average rate of change of the amount, in millions of dollars per year, that the NFS granted to museums in Minnesota from 2000 to 2006?

The histogram summarizes a data set of the weights, in pounds, of 14 salmon. If an additional weight of 85 pounds is added to the original data set to create a new data set of 15 weights of salmon, which of the following measures must be greater for the new data set than for the original data set?
I. The median
II. The mean
questions.explanation: Adding a value larger than every other value always raises the mean. The old median (average of the 7th and 8th values) and the new median (the 8th value) both fall in the 15–20 bin and could be equal, so the median need not increase.

questions.question: The speed of a white-throated needletail, a type of bird, in flight was measured to be 49 miles per hour. What was the white-throated needletail's measured speed, in kilometers per hour? (Use 1 mile = 1.6 kilometers.)
questions.explanation: 49 × 1.6 = 78.4 kilometers per hour.

questions.question: A science club from a high school in Ohio conducted an experiment on the effect of smell on taste. 80 students from the high school were selected at random. 32 were able to correctly identify the pureed food sample while wearing nose plugs. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the experiment can be generalized?
options: All students from high schools in Ohio
The 80 students who participated in the experiment
All students from the high school
The 32 students who correctly identified the food sample
questions.topic: Inference from sample statistics and margin of error

questions.question: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle A is 52° and AC = 35. In triangle PQR, the measure of angle P is 52° and PR = 105. Which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that triangle ABC is similar to triangle PQR?
options: The measures of angle B and angle R are 34° and 94°, respectively.
The measures of angle B and angle Q are 52° and 34°, respectively.
questions.explanation: With B = 34°, angle C = 180 − 52 − 34 = 94°. With P = 52° and R = 94°, angle Q = 34°, so all three angles match and the triangles are similar by AA.

questions.question: In the triangle shown, RS = √157. What is the value of sin R?
questions.explanation: ST = √(79² − 157) = √(6,084) = 78. sin R = opposite/hypotenuse = ST/RT = 78/79.

questions.question: Square A has side lengths that are 192 times the side lengths of square B. The area of square A is k times the area of square B. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Areas scale by the square of the side ratio: k = 192² = 36,864.

In the xy−plane, the graph of the linear function h contains the points (0, 0) and (1, 32). Which equation defines h, where y = h(x)?
questions.explanation: The slope is (32 − 0)/(1 − 0) = 32 and the y-intercept is 0, so h(x) = 32x.

questions.question: To purchase a used car at a total price of 14,000 dollars, a onetime down payment is required, and then fixed monthly payments are made for the remaining amount owed for the car. The equation 14,000 = 2,800 + 200t represents this situation, where t is the number of fixed monthly payments that are made. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 200 in this context?
options: The amount, in dollars, of the down payment
The amount, in dollars, of each fixed monthly payment
The total amount, in dollars, paid for the car after t fixed monthly payments
The total number of fixed monthly payments
questions.explanation: 200 is multiplied by the number of monthly payments, so it is the amount of each monthly payment.

questions.question: The graph gives the estimated population y, in thousands, of a town x years since 2001, where 0 ≤ x ≤ 5. Which of the following best describes the increase in the estimated population from x = 0 to x = 1?
options: The estimated population at x = 1 is 0.5 times the estimated population at x = 0.
The estimated population at x = 1 is 1.5 times the estimated population at x = 0.
The estimated population at x = 1 is 2.5 times the estimated population at x = 0.
The estimated population at x = 1 is 3.5 times the estimated population at x = 0.
questions.explanation: The graph starts at about 5 at x = 0 and is about 7.5 at x = 1, a ratio of 1.5.

questions.question: The cost of renting a piece of equipment is $64n for the first day and $32n for each additional day, where n is a positive integer. Which of the following functions gives the cost C(x), in dollars, of renting this equipment for x days, where x is a positive integer?

questions.question: The function f is a quadratic function. In the xy−plane, the graph of y = f(x) has a vertex at (1, 6) and passes through the points (2, 40) and (−1, 142). What is the value of f(−2) − f(0)?

questions.explanation: The graph passes through (0, 13), so f(0) = 13 (indeed f(0) = a·4^0 = a = 13).

In triangle JKL, cos y° = 3132. What is the length of KL?
questions.explanation: In right triangle JKL, cos y° = KL/JL = KL/32 = 31/32, so KL = 31.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle A is 52° and AC = 40. In triangle PQR, the measure of angle P is 52° and PR = 120. Which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that triangle ABC is similar to triangle PQR?
options: The measures of angle B and angle R are 40° and 88°, respectively.
The measures of angle B and angle Q are 52° and 40°, respectively.
questions.explanation: With B = 40° and R = 88°, angle C = 180° − 52° − 40° = 88° = R, and angle Q = 40° = B, so the triangles are similar by AA.
